name: Bergheimat
beschreibung: Hotel Bergheimat is located in the peaceful municipality of Pfafflar in the Außerfern region. The family-run hotel provides accommodations in various room categories. The magnificent surroundings of the Lechtal Alps are perfect for hiking and cycling tours. In winter, guests can enjoy cross-country skiing or head to nearby ski resorts. The hotel's restaurant emphasizes high-quality local produce. Amenities include a guest garden and a cozy lounge. Pfafflar represents an idyllic retreat for pure nature experiences away from mainstream tourist crowds.
